fields.label: Infant Absorption Efficiency
fields.help: Infant absorption efficiency of the chemical by the oral route of exposure (i.e., fraction of ingested chemical that is absorbed by the infant). For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life.

fields.label: Maternal Absorption Efficiency
fields.help: Maternal absorption efficiency of the chemical by the oral route of exposure (i.e., fraction of ingested chemical that is absorbed by the mother). For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life.

fields.label: Fraction in Maternal Blood
fields.help: Fraction of steady-state total body burden of hydrophilic chemical in mother that is in the mother’s whole blood compartment. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life. Dioxins/furans are not hydrophilic, so this parameter does not apply to them.

fields.label: Fraction in Maternal Fat
fields.help: Fraction of steady-state lipophilic chemical body burden in mother that is stored in body fat. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life.

fields.label: Half-Life in Blood
fields.help: Biological half-life for chemical in non-lactating women. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life.

fields.label: Non-Lactating Elimination Rate
fields.help: Rate constant for elimination of chemical for non-lactating women. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life.

fields.label: Lactating Elimination Rate
fields.help: Rate constant for total elimination of hydrophilic chemicals by lactating women. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life. Dioxins/furans are not hydrophilic, so this parameter does not apply to them.

fields.label: Blood-Milk Partition Coefficient
fields.help: Partition coefficient for chemical between maternal blood plasma and aqueous phase of breast milk. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result form breast feeding in the first year of life. Dioxins/furans are not hydrophilic, so this parameter does not apply to them.

fields.label: Blood Cell-Plasma Partition Coefficient
fields.help: Partition coefficient for hydrophilic or protein-bound chemical between red blood cells (RBC) and plasma in maternal blood. For PB-HAPs assessed for RTR multipathway exposure, only for dioxins/furans is it possible for a substantial proportion of an individual's total lifetime cancer risk to result from breast feeding in the first year of life. Dioxins/furans are not hydrophilic, so this parameter does not apply to them.
